name: Swan Hill
source: Bureau of Meteorology, Water Data Online (KiWIS API)
datum: m above the local gauge zero (local gauge height; zero elevation not given by the API)
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0), per BoM Water Data Online copyright notice. Credit: Bureau of Meteorology, Water Data Online, with data supplied by the station owner (see notes).
notes: BoM series DMQaQc.Merged.DailyMean.24HR, ts_id 266242010, station_id 2877698 (station 409204 MURRAY @ SWAN HILL). Data owner: VIC - Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action.

Daily mean of the merged quality-controlled level record, aggregated by BoM to a 24-hour mean. The API does not say how many readings fed each early-year mean; where only one staff reading a day was taken, the 'mean' is that one reading.

Quality codes ({10: 'quality-A best available Quality', 90: 'quality-B compromised', 110: 'quality-C estimate'}): counts {10: 18186, 90: 49, 110: 719}. Mapping: A (10) and B (90, compromised) -> measured; C (110, estimate) -> estimated; E (140, unknown quality) -> measured before 1991 and provisional from 1991 on (0 days), where it marks recent unchecked readings.
Unknown-quality code E (140) share of days by decade: none.
Compromised code B (90) share of days by decade: {2010: 0.001, 2020: 0.018}.
14 empty timestamps (code -1) and 0 values coded F (210, missing or incorrect) were dropped.

measurement_history.fact: Data check: record starts with several readings a day, which fits a continuous recorder.
Many values in 1975-79 carry quality C (estimate); 27% of days in the 1970s are estimated.
Torrumbarry Weir (Lock 26), the nearest Murray weir upstream, was finished in 1924.
Not found: gauge moves, datum or zero changes, telemetry start, publisher accuracy statement.

public_notes: This record starts in late 1974. About a quarter of the days in the late 1970s were estimated by the data owner rather than measured.
